mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_role_perm ( menu_no , role_no , disp_yn , view_yn , ins_yn , upd_yn , del_yn , reg_user , reg_date ) SELECT menu_no , #{roleNo} , 'N' , 'N' , 'N' , 'N' , 'N' , #{regUser} , NOW() FROM menu WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_no AS menuNo , m.menu_name AS menuName , p.pro_path AS proPath , mrp.disp_perm AS dispPerm , mrp.view_perm AS viewPerm , mrp.ins_perm AS insPerm , mrp.upd_perm AS updPerm , mrp.del_perm AS delPerm FROM menu_role_perm mrp JOIN menu m ON mrp.menu_no = m.menu_no AND m.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN program p ON m.pro_no = p.pro_no AND p.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE mrp.role_no = #{roleNo};
